verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a built-in AI assistant inside Cekura that users can delegate tasks to. The Skills and MCP plugin let external coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor drive Cekura, which is client-side tooling rather than an in-product assistant. In-product AI features like auto-generated evaluators, AI-generated mock tool data and automatic fix suggestions are adjacent capabilities, not a delegatable assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
